The Project

A New Standard
of Urban Living

HOYA is not simply a building — it is a carefully conceived world unto itself. Positioned in the heart of New East Prishtina, Kosovo's most ambitious new economic quarter, it sets a new benchmark for what contemporary living can mean.

Every detail has been curated: from the architectural language that blends light and nature, to the social spaces that foster authentic human connection. HOYA is a place where residents don't just live — they belong.

Developed by Unitera, with a legacy of delivering excellence in Kosovo's real estate landscape, HOYA represents the pinnacle of thoughtful, sustainable development.

Architecture

Living Spaces
That Breathe

Every unit at HOYA opens onto generous terraces and balconies, framing views of green courtyards and the Prishtina skyline. The façade's warm travertine tones and deep loggias create a rhythm that changes with the light — alive at dusk, serene at dawn.

The distinctive sage-green ground floor activates the street level, housing curated retail and commercial spaces that bring life to every corner of the complex.

Ecology

Nature Woven
Into Every Floor

HOYA's stepped terraces are not decorative — they are living ecosystems. Mature trees grow from the building itself, bioswales manage rainfall naturally, and vertical greening filters air while regulating the microclimate.

This is architecture that gives back to its environment, creating a genuinely regenerative urban block in the heart of Kosovo's capital.

What Sets HOYA Apart

Crafted for Those Who
Expect More

Premium Residences

Carefully designed apartments maximising natural light, generous ceiling heights, and open onto private outdoor spaces rare in urban environments.

Living Ecology

Wetlands, bioswales, raingardens, and vertical greening integrate deeply into the structure, creating a regenerative microclimate for every resident.

Strategic Location

Positioned at New East Prishtina's epicentre — with direct access to key institutions, commercial hubs, schools, and leisure destinations.

Masterplanned Complex

Five distinctive towers designed as a unified whole — connected courtyards, shared green spaces, and civic amenities woven throughout the masterplan.

Community by Design

Social spaces, shared courtyards, and cultural zones create opportunities for authentic connection between residents and the wider neighbourhood.

Investment Value

Located in Kosovo's most rapidly growing economic corridor, HOYA is a high-value asset in a market defined by consistent upward momentum.

Where You'll Be

Perfectly Placed in
New Prishtina

HOYA occupies one of the most coveted addresses in Kosovo's capital — New East Prishtina, the city's most ambitious and fastest-growing district. Here, the energy of a modern metropolis meets the calm of thoughtfully designed green space.

  • Direct access to Prishtina's main institutional corridor
  • Minutes from the city's top commercial centres
  • Integrated into a masterplanned green network
  • Proximity to international schools & healthcare
  • Connected to Kosovo's primary transport arteries
  • Surrounded by rising real estate value
The Vision
Architecture that breathes — a living environment where nature and urban life thrive together, and every resident finds their own art of living.
